top5.title: A software update reportedly caused flights to stop across the United States
top5.description: An update to L3Harris’s private network reportedly caused communications used by U.S. air traffic control to fail. The FAA lifted the flight stoppage after more than four hours, but delays are expected to continue for several days.
top5.why: A software update that grounded U.S. flights for hours exposes the systemic risk created by concentration in critical aviation communications infrastructure.

top5.title: Anthropic’s IPO is reportedly oversubscribed sixfold
top5.description: Anthropic’s IPO is reportedly oversubscribed sixfold and could become the largest in history.
top5.why: Anthropic’s reportedly sixfold-oversubscribed IPO would signal extraordinary investor demand for leading AI companies and could reset private and public-market valuations.

top5.title: AI risks are the biggest threat to the financial system
top5.description: A Federal Reserve survey finds that artificial intelligence risks are considered the biggest threat to the financial system.
top5.why: The Federal Reserve’s identification of AI as the biggest threat to financial stability signals that AI risk is moving from a technology concern to a core regulatory and market issue.

top5.title: ByteDance is reportedly preparing a buyback valuing the company at $400 billion
top5.description: TikTok owner ByteDance is reportedly preparing a share buyback of up to $6 billion, based on a valuation of around $400 billion.
top5.why: ByteDance’s reported $400 billion valuation would make it one of the world’s most valuable private technology companies despite continuing geopolitical and regulatory uncertainty around TikTok.

top5.title: Solar power and batteries are reportedly the cheapest option for AI data centers
top5.description: A study estimates that on-site solar power paired with batteries is becoming the cheapest option for AI data centers in 85% of U.S. regions. It attributes this advantage to faster construction, which allows computing capacity to be added more quickly.
top5.why: Cheaper, faster-to-deploy solar power and batteries could materially change how AI data centers are financed, located and connected to the U.S. power grid.
